Shift into the Weekend MTB Ride

Queen Creek, AZ · San Tan Mountain Regional Park · Mountain bike · Gravel

Shift into the Weekend MTB Ride is a mountain bike and gravel group ride in Queen Creek, AZ. It rolls third Saturday of the month at 7:00 am from San Tan Mountain Regional Park.

Next ride Sat, Oct 17, 7:00 AM MST

For visitors

Join the Meetup group, request to join, then RSVP. Bring water, snacks, a helmet and a spare tube. Park entry (as listed Sept 2026): a Maricopa County annual pass, $10 per vehicle, or $5 on foot or by bike. Some months the group also lists an edition at Usery Mountain Regional Park, so read the event's location.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: solid pace with regroups; gravel crunch and dirt flow. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @santan_shredders the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Shift into the Weekend MTB Ride group ride

A monthly Saturday-morning mountain or gravel ride at San Tan Mountain Regional Park. The host calls it no-drop, with regroups often and a mix of gravel and dirt. Santan Shredders runs it on the third Saturday of each month.
